title: Freeze checker: accept a manifest in a linked worktree's own git directory
outcome: Reported by Engram::Opus (2026-09-25 ~03:37 UTC, delegations 15194846/session-7591 Codex and 3ba1c514/session-7592 Claude, cwd C:\github\Personal\Engram\.worktrees\engram-family). termal_review_freeze_check refused the manifest at the path 'git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path engram-review-freeze.json' prints for that linked worktree (C:\github\Personal\Engram\.git\worktrees\engram-family1\engram-review-freeze.json), with 'manifest must be inside the review worktree' (src/review_freeze.rs:385, check_review_freeze requires manifest_path.starts_with(git.root)). In a linked worktree the per-worktree git dir lives under the main repository's .git/worktrees/<name> (whose name may differ from the folder), not under the worktree root, so the location Engram's /review-changes skill prescribes can never pass; the Codex reviewer failed and the Claude reviewer stayed unverified. Fix direction: also accept a manifest inside this worktree's own git dir, as 'git rev-parse --git-dir' reports it for the review root (canonicalized, the per-worktree dir only, not the common dir or another worktree's), keeping the parent-traversal and canonical-prefix checks; add a linked-worktree test. Workaround meanwhile: <worktree>/.review/engram-review-freeze.json excluded via .git/info/exclude.
